metadata.title: NP-completeness of aggregate root-dependent spanning-tree cost
metadata.description:
For one common undirected spanning tree, every vertex root induces a whole-tree orientation whose arc costs are independently supplied. This preprint proves NP-completeness of deciding whether the sum of all root costs is at most a threshold, even with costs in {0,1,2}; a uniform shift gives costs in {1,2,3}. The self-contained satisfiability reduction resolves Problem 1 in Volker Kaibel's November 2018 Oberwolfach workshop contribution, whose report was published in December 2019. Standard-library exact verification files accompany the proof.

No earlier proof of the exact objective was located in the bounded source and model audit completed on 6 October 2026; no absolute-first or continued-open-status claim is made. AI tools were used extensively in solving, drafting, literature checking, code generation, verification and adversarial audits. This manuscript has not received conventional human peer review or refereeing.
